text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered: latency-slo-p95-burn for service=runtime-gateway pool=prod-gpu-1
PagerDuty: Incident PGT-4821 fired -> paging mike (oncall) and chris

mike (oncall): acked. I'm looking. seeing p95 climb across eu-west and us-west.
chris: thx — joining. any idea if it's KV cache related?
mike (oncall): initial glance shows increased tail at tokenization stage. throughput steady, latency per-request up.
PagerDuty: mike (oncall) acknowledged the alert (ack id: ack-3467890123). Escalation timer set to 7m.

maria: @mike can you paste the query pattern or sample payload? curious if batch sizes spiked.
mike (oncall): sample payloads look normal. suspecting hot-path where batching/eviction overlaps. pulling recent spans..
chris: grabbing traces from jaeger for request ids hitting high p95.

mike (oncall): logs snippet:
```
2026-03-14T12:00:10Z service=runtime-gateway req_id=aa7f p95=312ms p99=610ms kv_hit=false batch_size=1
2026-03-14T12:00:11Z service=runtime-gateway req_id=bb3c p95=298ms p99=542ms kv_hit=false batch_size=1
2026-03-14T12:00:12Z service=runtime-gateway req_id=cc9a p95=325ms p99=680ms kv_hit=false batch_size=1
```
mike (oncall): noticed kv_hit=false across spikes. could be KVCACHE eviction storm.

anne: are autoscaler logs showing recent scale-down or GPU churn?
mike (oncall): autoscaler stable. node count unchanged. no recent deploys.
chris: I see sustained small batches and high KV lookup latency in sidecar metrics. looks like a mem pressure eviction on sidecar causing KV warmups.
maria: any customers affected? metrics: user-facing p95 for requests with large context is hitting 350ms, but error rate stable.
devops-sam: infra noticed increased OOM events on sidecar process for a subset of pods ~12:00Z. restarting sidecar resolved memory briefly.

mike (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) increase sidecar memory limit for affected deployment to 1.5x, 2) apply temporary KV-prefetch flag to runtime-gateway (config toggle), 3) route small-context traffic to fallback pool (prod-gpu-2) for 10m.
chris: +1. I'll roll the sidecar memory bump as canary (2 pods), monitor p95 for 5m, then roll.
maria: notify support with customer-impact note: degraded latency (p95 up to ~350-600ms) for inference requests with cold KV. no data loss.

PagerDuty: Escalation pending in 5m if ack still active.

mike (oncall): starting canary memory bump now. command:
```
kubectl set resources deployment/runtime-sidecar -n prod --limits=memory=1Gi --requests=512Mi --containers=sidecar
```
mike (oncall): canary applied to 2 pods. monitoring...
chris: seeing p95 drop on canary pods to ~180ms within 90s. good signal.
mike (oncall): rolling to remaining pods in batch of 10%. proceeding.

anne: adding incident-channel note and creating lightweight incident doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PGT-4821 (created) — tagging SRE and infra.
maria: customer-impact drafted: "Transient latency degradation (p95 up to ~600ms) for small percentage of requests between 12:00–12:18 UTC due to sidecar memory pressure and KV warmups. No errors observed; failover and rollouts mitigated impact." posting to #support now.

PagerDuty: mike (oncall) updated incident urgency to medium. Escalation canceled.

devops-sam: post-rollout, sidecar OOMs dropped to zero. global p95 baseline returned near pre-incident within 8 minutes of full rollout. p99 improved but still a little noisy (~520ms).
chris: follow-ups: 1) root cause triage for KV eviction pattern, 2) consider increasing default sidecar memory or smarter eviction policy, 3) add a prefetched-KV healthcheck to runtime-gateway cold-paths.
mike (oncall): assigning follow-up tickets to infra and runtime: PGT-4822 (kv-eviction-triage), PGT-4823 (sidecar-memory-review), PGT-4824 (prefetch-healthcheck).

maria: support notified customers in impacted orgs and linked incident doc.
anne: handing off to next oncall: chris will take postmortem lead and follow-ups. next shift starts in 30m; chris please ack handoff.
chris: acked. I'll pick up postmortem.
mike (oncall): closing live mitigation thread. monitoring for 15m, will update incident doc with timeline. thanks all :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident PGT-4821 status -> mitigated (live).
